description: Analysis settings (PLAN.md phase 7). The exchange rate converts the annual cost from USD to EUR [PK7, M4]: one rate, stated in the thesis as an assumption; M4 asks for the ECB euro reference rate of the main run day, so replace it then. usdPerEur is the ECB form (1 EUR = usdPerEur USD); null = not set, then the EUR columns are empty.
rateSource: the ECB euro reference rate of 6.11.2026 (1 EUR = 1.1165 USD), https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-hist-90d.xml; the main run ran 6.11.2026 23:25 - 7.11.2026 02:52 UTC, and 7.11.2026 is a Saturday without a reference rate
